about_the_game:
🧩 About This Game
Explore the endless mysteries of the Rubik’s Cube!
This is a puzzle game designed for cube enthusiasts, featuring a variety of classic and advanced cube models, including:

  • Standard Cube

  • Pyraminx

  • Dodecahedron Cube

With more unique variations continuously in development!

Whether you are a beginner or a speedcubing master, this game will let you experience the joy of solving puzzles and push the limits of your spatial thinking!

🎮 Key Features

🧠 Realistic Simulation – Physics-based rotation and structure simulation for an authentic cube-solving experience.

🧩 Variety of Cube Types – Includes both common and rare cube models, with gradually increasing difficulty.

🕹️ Smooth Controls – Supports both mouse and keyboard for intuitive rotation.

📈 Solve Timer – Built-in timer to track your progress and help you improve toward speedcubing mastery.

👥 Who Is This Game For

  • Players who enjoy cubes, geometry, and spatial imagination

  • Puzzle lovers who want to train their mind, dexterity, and memory

  • Speedcubers who wish to practice different cube models in a virtual space

  • Educators or demonstrators looking for tools to explain 3D geometry

🔧 Coming Soon

  • Online leaderboards

  • Daily challenges

  • More rare and unique cube structures currently in development

short_description: "Cube Cube 2" is an immersive 3D Rubik’s Cube simulator featuring various popular cube types like the classic 3x3, Pyraminx, Mirror Cube, and Megaminx. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, enjoy fun and challenges tailored to all skill levels.
